project: Edge AI for Sustainable Shrimp Disease Diagnostics

datasets.name: ShrimpDiseaseImageBD
notes: The outer archive contains nested Raw Images and Annotated Diseased Shrimp Images ZIP files.
The annotated set provides one YOLO text label file per diseased image.
The paper reports 416 individual shrimp, so specimen-aware splitting is required if IDs can be recovered.

datasets.name: TigerShrimpBD
notes: Use the Original directory as source data.
Do not randomly split the provided Augmented directory; augmented variants can leak source-image information across splits.
Use primarily as a secondary dataset/generalization test because it targets tiger shrimp and has severe original-class imbalance.

scope_warning: Neither downloadable field-image dataset provides an EMS/AHPND class. A published 1357-image AHPND/EHP/HPV/Normal dataset uses 100x histopathology images and is not publicly available because of institutional restrictions. Do not claim EMS/AHPND detection in the initial system.
